confidence_notes: June 2026 Philadelphia price averages anchor meals, coffee, and beer. Cocktail and wine prices are less certain; wine is estimated from its local price relationship to draft beer. Lodging is a broad model estimate with substantial variation by July dates.
comparable_city_reasoning: Food and drink use Philadelphia price data; lodging is broadly calibrated to a major northeastern U.S. city, below New York and Washington, D.C. pricing.
